name: Explosion
knownUsers: Katsuki Bakugo / 爆豪勝己 — original user; later aliases omitted
sourceMedium: Main-series anime; manga references not yet verified for this entry
continuity: Main-series quirk. Source medium and continuity are recorded separately; no additional continuity claim is made.
firstCharacterAppearance: Not yet verified against primary episode material.
firstDemonstration: TV season/episode not yet verified from primary demonstration material. The episode 1 synopsis alone is not proof of a quirk demonstration.
firstNamedExplanation: Official character page confirms the Japanese quirk label. The first named TV explanation has not been verified.
lore: Bakugo's official character profile describes explosive, nitro-like material produced by sweat glands in his palms. The guide omits later-series identity/story details.
adaptation: This mod turns palm explosions into a bounded pressure/mobility kit. Every resource value, cooldown, training circuit and numerical effect is a gameplay adaptation. Original move names are identified in their descriptions; canonical-name research is tracked separately.
role: Emitter / close-to-mid-range pressure, precision and recoil traversal
resource: Stamina and blast strain. Accepted startup pays costs and cooldown; interrupted casts do not refund them.
drawback: Underwater casts are rejected. High strain and low stamina restrict demanding moves; neither prevents basic survival actions. Recoil does not remove collision or fall damage.
counters: Solid cover blocks target acquisition and rays.
Armour, shields, teams and PvP policy follow the server's combat rules.
Heavy attacks consume enough strain to limit repetition.
nonCombatUtility: Short recoil traversal and access to raised routes.
Course/rescue contributions with a support-first progression alternative.
No excavation, container duplication or destructive terrain power is advertised.
equipment: The original Cadet suit is equipment with ordinary armour behavior. It does not assign a quirk or unlock a technique.
acquisition: Current development starting pool: Explosion only. Creative/operator token restores earned mastery. Ordinary rerolls do not spend a token when no alternative exists.
verification: Identity and palm-explosion principle verified from the official character profile. The named Japanese Howitzer attack is corroborated by the official episode 25 synopsis; its English localisation remains a working label. No unverified first-demonstration claim is published.
